notes: tavolashop.com is a live, actively-trading UAE specialty kitchenware/bakeware/cookware/tableware retailer (site tagline: 'TavolaShop.com #1 Stop for Bakeware, Cookware & Appliances in UAE') -- NOT a general home-decor store; no closure signals (normal storefront, active promos). No prior extraction in this project (no duplicate-company flag). Full nav mapped from a fetched mega-menu (283 unique category paths across appliances, bakeware, brands, cake-decoration, cookware, edibles, kitchen-tools, knives, on-the-go, outdoor-dining, table-home, tea-coffee) -- only two branches fall inside project scope: Mirrors (table-home/homeware) and a subset of Tableware/Coffee-Tea-Serveware product-type nodes (table-home/tableware + tea-coffee/coffee-tea-serveware + tea-coffee/tea/tea-pots), filed under Kitchen & Dining per the brief's Tableware/Glassware inclusion rule. 'brands/decor' in the nav is a BRAND page for 'Decor' (an Australian food-storage-container brand -- glass canisters, snack tubs, measuring jugs; confirmed via product slugs decor-glass-bamboo-canister, decor-go-dip-tub-set-of-6 etc.), not a home-decor category -- correctly excluded as brand listing + non-decor products. ACCESS ROUTE: Cloudflare Turnstile JS challenge blocks all direct fetch (curl_cffi, 9-15 impersonation profiles tested across two attempts, all 403 'Just a moment...') and r.jina.ai (also Cloudflare-challenged on this zone). translate.goog proxying of individual clean-URL category pages succeeds and renders full Magento HTML with live toolbar counts -- used as the sole working route throughout. ROBOTS.TXT (Rule 3 check): translate.goog serves a synthetic generic 'User-agent: *\nDisallow: /' (200, text/plain) for the /robots.txt path on ANY domain proxied through it -- verified as a proxy artifact, not real site policy, by requesting robots.txt for wikipedia.org and example.com through the identical translate.goog mechanism and getting the same bogus 'Disallow: /' (example.com) or a Google 404 (wikipedia.org), neither of which reflects those sites' actual robots.txt. Real robots.txt retrieved via a Wayback Machine snapshot: only 'User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: /' is a full-site block; 'User-agent: *' is restricted only to internal Magento admin/system paths (app/, bin/, checkout/, customer/, wishlist/, etc.) and index.php-style URLs, not to product/category browsing. No ClaudeBot/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot/Claude-Web entry anywhere. No Claude-specific block -- WAF bypass via translate.goog is clear under Rule 3. COUNT VERIFICATION: qty taken from the Magento toolbar text -- 'N Item(s)' when the category fits one page, 'Items 1-36 of N' when paginated -- the standard reliable Magento evidence pattern used elsewhere in this project. Spot-checked on Mirrors: toolbar said 6, and the page's product tiles independently enumerated to exactly 6 unique titles -- no inflation detected on this Magento instance. RULE 0.6 DEDUP: 'Sensor Mirrors' (table-home/homeware/sensor-mirrors, toolbar 5) is a pure subset of 'Mirrors' (table-home/homeware/mirrors, toolbar 6) -- alt-text comparison shows the identical 5 simplehuman Sensor Mirror SKUs (Trio, Trio Max, Round, Mini w/Travel Case Rose Gold, Fold w/Travel Case) present verbatim on both pages, with Mirrors adding just one more SKU (ZWILLING TWINOX LED Makeup Mirror). Sensor Mirrors is therefore dropped as a duplicate facet per Rule 0.6, not counted as a second leaf; the single Mirrors leaf (qty 6) already covers the full unique set. EXCLUDED (checked, out of project scope): appliances/*, back-to-school, bakeware/* (all), brands + brands/decor, cake-decoration/*, cookware/*, deals/new-arrivals (never-extract), edibles/*, kitchen-tools/*, knives/*, on-the-go/* (travel gear: lunch boxes, travel mugs, water bottles), outdoor-dining/bbq-grills, /cooler-bags, /grill-bbq-tools, /picnic-baskets, /pocket-knives (functional/travel), ramadan and summer-season (seasonal promo rollups, treated like Holiday & Gift), tea-coffee/coffee/* and tea-coffee/tea/* functional items (coffee-machines, grinders, kettles, moka-pot, syphon, tea-infusers-strainers, tea-leaves-bags, tea-press, tea-warmers -- appliances/tools/consumables) except tea-coffee/tea/tea-pots which was kept as genuine decorative/functional teapot serveware (toolbar 28, matches the 'Teapots' sub_category precedent used elsewhere in this project), table-home/homeware/aprons (textile), /bathroom-tools (checked: toothbrush holders, toilet brushes, shower caddies, soap dish -- functional bathroom fixtures, not decorative), /candles-fragrances (checked: exactly 1 SKU on the page, 'PME Extra Tall Candles with Holders, Set of 16' -- a cake-decorating candle multipack, not a home-decor/ambient candle; Home-Fragrance-named category correctly excluded regardless), /cleaning-organisation, /dish-racks, /floor-mats (textile), /magnets, /personal-care, /pet-bowls, /soap-dispensers, /tweezers, /waste-bins, table-home/tableware/cutlery-sets (cutlery), /placemats and /tablecloths-napkins-table-linens (textiles), /serving-tools (utensils), tea-coffee/coffee-tea-serveware/coffee-tea-spoons (utensil), /thermal-flasks and /travel-mugs-presses (on-the-go travel drinkware, not home tableware). Also inspected and DROPPED: outdoor-dining/outdoor-dining-serving (toolbar 100 items) -- a mixed promotional roll-up combining trays/bowls/pitchers with out-of-scope item types (an Abaca cutlery holder, an Abaca placemat) under one 'Outdoor Dining & Serving' merchandising banner, with product brands (Gien, Guzzini) and item types overlapping the dedicated Trays/Serving-Bowls/Water-Carafes-and-Jugs nodes already captured elsewhere -- treated as a mixed roll-up per 'drop them, don't pad', not a distinct product-type category. Kitchen & Dining is split into two sub_category parents mirroring the site's own nav split: 'Tableware' (table-home/tableware/*) and 'Coffee & Tea Serveware' (tea-coffee/coffee-tea-serveware/* plus tea-pots).
